scientific_question: Can equal-state layer-private full-rank diagonal--mixed-radix transports move one learned global frame into all twelve depth-specific dense-MLP function/JVP manifolds under one percent persistent state?

frozen_teacher.procedural_parent_policy: Use exact step-zero MLP tensors in the audit; exclude them from compact state and require independent config-seed regeneration identity before any later model training.

frozen_function_inventory.activation_anchor: exact per-layer mean of frozen training inputs, charged as FP16

frozen_representation.formula: y0_l=f0_l(x); hard codes route through factored scores; xin=P_in_l(x-mu_l); t=P_out_l U(q_l*(V^T xin)); yhat_l=y0_l+sum_m g_lmk C_mk+o_l+t
frozen_representation.transport_formula: P(s1,s2,s3)=diag(1+s1) F diag(1+s2) F diag(1+s3), F=Q3 tensor H256, Q3=I-(2/3)11T
frozen_representation.routing_forward: hard argmax independently in each of three banks
frozen_representation.routing_backward_during_fit: straight-through softmax with frozen temperature 1.0 for parameter gradients
frozen_representation.routing_jvp_for_fit_and_gate: exact hard piecewise-affine local derivative, excluding routing-boundary derivative
frozen_representation.mixer_storage: none; normalized H256 and Q3 are generated procedurally

initialization.initial_function: exact step-zero procedural MLP because codebook, tangent U, and offsets are zero; every transport is also exact identity because F squared is identity

fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact hard piecewise-affine input-JVP MSE
fit.optimizer: AdamW on compact coordinates except frozen charged activation anchors
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all twelve layers

controls.step_zero_parent: zero codebook, tangent U, and output offsets
controls.input_transport_only: retain fitted input transport and set output transport to identity
controls.output_transport_only: retain fitted output transport and set input transport to identity
controls.one_conjugated_diagonal_stage: retain only the middle learned diagonal, conjugated by F on each side
controls.coordinate_diagonal_only: remove both F applications and multiply the three fitted diagonals coordinatewise
controls.shared_across_layers: replace each diagonal bank by its exact across-layer mean bank
controls.piecewise_tangent_only: zero codebook and offsets while retaining transported tangent
controls.hard_value_only: zero tangent U and offsets; exact JVP must equal parent JVP
controls.initial_random_router: replace fitted router factors by deterministic initialization
controls.dense_teacher: exact terminal teacher output and input-JVP identity

runtime_gates.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callbacks plus one resettable 90-minute heartbeat for any run observed or projected above five minutes
